notes.title: Demo Update #1
notes.notes:
Hello diligent cartographers🗺️ !
We just uploaded a new patch for the demo and these are the things we addressed:


 Fixed getting stuck in the treasure found screen after respawning,
 Fixed jump breaking after cancelling step count midair,
 Fixed tab captions disappearing in options menu when switching the language,
 Fixed flying trees,


Thank you for playing and we will keep you updated with further improvements we're adding! ✨

And consider leaving a review on our demo page to share your feedback!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3672480/Map_Map__A_Game_About_Maps_Demo/
